description:
The image depicts a train engine sitting on a track.

The train engine is primarily orange, with black and yellow accents. The front of the engine features a large, black-framed headlight, while the side displays the letters "BNSF" in black, accompanied by the numbers "7097" in larger black font. A black railing encircles the engine, and a concrete platform extends from the front of the train.

In the foreground, a patch of grass is visible in the bottom-right
